context: Stopped before any model context because priority verification failed; later attempt completed separately.

model_settings.seed_policy: Each single-context call uses that exact historical context seed

preparation_policy.offset_removal: Independent full-preparation-interval arithmetic mean per channel, before resampling; offsets not restored
preparation_policy.target_isolation: Each target is centered/filtered independently; target values or statistics never enter retained inputs or reference
preparation_policy.preparation_filter: scipy.signal.butter order4 bandpass 0.5-40 Hz at 256 Hz; scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt default odd extension
preparation_policy.timestamp_policy: Unchanged source-fractional-index interpolation; no time shift, gap filling or waveform alignment
preparation_policy.comparison_filter: Unchanged common post-prediction order4 0.5-40 Hz zero-phase pass on measured/spline/Zuna branches
preparation_policy.model_context_policy: Unchanged five-second independent contexts and existing reflected-tail behavior
preparation_policy.evaluation_mask_policy: Unchanged caller-governed exclusions; no amplitude- or outcome-selected exclusion
preparation_policy.limitation: Linear endpoint extension and centering mitigate DC-padding artifacts, not all filter transients or model seams; not a live/causal implementation

primary_endpoint.arrays: whole-block common post-prediction 0.5–40 Hz SOS zero-phase filter, separately applied to each branch/block
primary_endpoint.metric: mean of four per-electrode NMSEs over the original evaluation mask
primary_endpoint.filter_asymmetry_disclosed: measured/spline have preparation plus comparison filter; model output has comparison filter

mandatory_companion.arrays: saved whole-block-prepared measured targets/spline and raw model outputs before final comparison filter
mandatory_companion.mask: identical original mask, not a substitute selected based on the winner
mandatory_companion.metrics: same definitions as primary; always publish both endpoints

record.descriptive_strata: See immutable strata_predeclared.json/.npz; original proxy labels never become exclusions or confirmed blinks
record.spectral_policy: Welch 2 s Hann, 50% overlap, constant detrend, within contiguous eligible spans; never concatenate across gaps for PSD
record.seam_policy: genuine internal full-context transitions only, separate pre/post-filter jumps; block transitions reported separately or excluded explicitly
record.tail_diagnostic: On a diagnostic copy only, replace each 3–7-sample final generated tail by the preceding generated value, reapply the same within-block comparison filter, and quantify changes inside the unchanged original evaluation mask. Never substitute this diagnostic into either endpoint.
decision_logic: Successful execution is distinct from practical reconstruction benefit.
Report full outcomes and every block/channel regardless of direction; no significance or population claim.
Within each preparation compare Zuna with interpolation against that same prepared measured target.
If endpoints disagree or improvements concentrate narrowly, call the result mixed, not general superiority.
Any numerical usefulness margin must be chosen before future untouched sessions, not fitted to this recording.
A negative result is a valid endpoint; no automatic settings/seed/filter sweep.

runtime_policy.retry: NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY; any resume requires separate authorization and exact checkpoint identity

limitations: Previously inspected single recording; historical BENCH/QC evidence remains intact.
Held-out measured electrodes contain possible artifact and are not clean neural ground truth.
Host-derived eye-state timing is approximate and lacks independent ALS-barcode verification.
Template geometry retains disclosed Cz/Pz coordinate clipping.
Full-block centering/filtering is offline/noncausal; five-second model seams and tiny reflected tails remain explicit.
Historical and corrected prepared targets differ; changes in absolute error are not a pure model-accuracy effect.
No denoising, clinical, sparse-montage, decoder or live-control claim.
